name: piggymetrics
description: PiggyMetrics: Spring Boot + Spring Cloud (Feign, Zuul, Config Server) microservices. Ground truth curated by reading the source and the shared configuration, not by running TIA.
curated_by: reading the code at the pinned commit (2026-10-30); every dependency names the line that proves it

source.how_to_get_it: git clone https://github.com/sqshq/piggymetrics <dir>  (then: git -C <dir> checkout <commit>). It is only copied and parsed, never built or run.

config.why: Each service's servlet context path is set in config/src/main/resources/shared/<service>.yml (server.servlet.context-path), outside the service's own code. Feign clients call '/uaa/users' while the controller maps '/users'; an operator states the context paths once in the tenant configuration (paths.strip_prefixes).
